mentions.name: Myth
mentions.description: A browser-based platformer game where the player can become 1-dimensional and follow surfaces as a line, with jump (Space) and attack (E) controls. Built to run in a web browser.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A platformer game where you can become 1 dimensional and follow surfaces as a line: https://myth-game.pages.dev

Curious if it works on your browser.
